comparisonLimits: Full Suite, exact Host, 120x40, two foreground children, automatic parent Naming and Usage; Code Mode and old Ledger remain explicit per sample.
Each run stages fresh private configuration and temporary source caches. Kernel page cache is not reset. No resource run overlaps tests or profiling.
The environment restarted before 8UraCb. Pre-restart resource totals are not same-boot paired savings.
CPU scopes include the Host and descendants, not the observer. Final RSS is a snapshot; charged-memory peak is not peak process-tree RSS or allocation.
Per-process I/O includes only live members at readout and kernel-aggregated waited children; it is not complete process-tree I/O.
Diagnostic probes perturb scheduling. Their zero exit is not frozen-gate acceptance; CPU profiles have substantial additional overhead.
Earlier passing and failing intermediate sources do not certify the final source. No stable whole-Host CPU, RSS, allocation, GC or wakeup saving is inferred.
Historical late 9LkXjG 270.053281 ms and U4SAr9 489.594 ms holds lack direct causal traces. Subsequent passes do not retrospectively attribute them.
